verdict.rationale: The question applies to Browserbase, since it is a metered browser-session and fetch service. However, nothing in the evidence pack says whether failed, blocked, or empty-result requests count against billing quota. The evidence covers sessions, search, fetch, webhooks, SDK and observability, but none of it addresses billing treatment of failed requests.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether failed, blocked, or empty-result requests still consume my billing quota
